title: Vortex Cola Slushie 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Cola Slushie combines the classic taste of Cola with a fizzy, icy twist. This playful and nostalgic flavour captures the essence of a chilled Cola slushie beverage – familiar, tangy Cola swimming in crushed Ice, offering a refreshing and satisfying vape experience. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Cola Slushie provides smooth vapour and bold flavour, ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like pod kits and starter systems. The nicotine salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and fast-acting nicotine relief, perfect for everyday vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are available in a convenient 10ml format, offering a longer-lasting and more cost-effective alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cola Slushie is an excellent choice for vapers seeking nostalgic and refreshing flavours.
